That means two things: putting customers' voices, results and stories in front of the next buyer, and marketing our customers themselves, so the teams who build on Fireworks are seen and celebrated as advocates. Our customers are shipping some of the most interesting AI products in the world, from AI-native startups to some of the largest enterprises. The buyers we most want to reach trust their peers more than they trust us. You'll build the references, stories and peer moments that let customers at their scale and in their industry make the case for Fireworks, and you'll turn the champions inside our accounts into advocates who bring Fireworks to the next team. This is a hands-on role with full ownership. You'll set the strategy, build and run the programs, working through cross-functional partners and outside help like agencies or freelancers where it makes sense. As the programs prove their impact, you'll help shape how the function grows. You'll report to the Head of Global Strategic Events and work daily with Sales, Revenue Marketing, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Product and Strategic Events. Our buyers range from the engineers and ML leads who evaluate Fireworks to the CIOs, CTOs and AI platform owners who sign off. jobs.title: Privacy Program Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Privacy Program Engineer to own the technical core of our privacy program. We've achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and SOC 2 Type II, and we run active GDPR and CCPA/CPRA programs - now we need someone to run the machinery that keeps all of it working, and to make that machinery largely run itself. This is a privacy role with real technical depth - you'll write scripts, queries, and automation. From day one you'll own real workstreams: data subject requests, the data inventory and ROPA, hands-on privacy reviews for new vendors and features.. You'll report to our Privacy Lead and be a key owner of large portions of our privacy program, as well as the key technical expert on the privacy team. This is not a ticket queue with a title. We're a small team at a company that builds AI infrastructure, and we intend to leverage it - you'll own the direction and design of the technical systems, automations, and tools that help us meet our privacy obligations at Fireworks. WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR - You build systems, not queues. You've used AI tooling, automation, scripting, or workflow platforms to eliminate manual privacy work. - You're technical enough to be dangerous. You read code to understand what a service actually does with data. You can query a database without asking for help. jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Bolingbrook, IL
jobs.description_text: About the team: Formic's Marketing Team is the growth engine behind our commercial expansion. We move fast, experiment boldly, and build systems that scale. We work in close lockstep with Sales, RevOps, and Leadership to generate pipeline, sharpen our message, and get in front of the right manufacturers at the right time. This team is small, high-impact, and driven - and we're looking for someone who can match that energy. About this role: As our Head of Marketing, you will build, optimize, and lead a scalable engine for creating demand and qualified pipeline. You will own how Formic shows up in the market, how we identify and reach the manufacturers we can help, and how we turn that engagement into high quality opportunities for Sales. This is a broad, hands-on role spanning Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering and managing a team to deliver across those areas. You'll bring those capabilities together around a common goal: creating qualified pipeline and quantifying through data and insights what's driving it. As Formic grows, you'll help determine how the team and these capabilities evolve. We're looking for someone who combines creativity with operating rigor. You'll set strategy, but you'll stay close enough to the work to understand what's actually happening. You'll establish clear priorities, ownership, and metrics, and make decisions based on results. When something works, you'll scale it. When it doesn't, you'll change it or stop doing it

You understand the full institutional trade lifecycle end to end, and how it maps — and doesn't map — onto digital asset rails. You will partner directly with DIS leads on the vision and strategy for our custom build engagements, co-own product direction for those builds, and translate complex institutional requirements into specs that engineering can execute against without guesswork. You are comfortable challenging assumptions — client-side and internal — and pushing back when a requirement doesn't hold up against how the lifecycle actually operates, on either side of the TradFi/digital asset divide.
